visual_identity.technique: Layered dry-brushing; highlights use 'Pyrite Gold' impasto to create a metallic, mineral-flecked skin texture.
visual_identity.lighting: Atmospheric scattering; soft, diffused 'Limestone White' glow from above hitting the powerful neck muscles.
visual_identity.patterning: High-contrast 'Charcoal' banding on the flippers, rendered with aggressive, quick palette-knife swipes.

pose: Mid-water column hover in an 'S-curve' banking turn, showcasing the intermediate neck length characteristic of Rhomaleosaurids.
